findings.title: Removed public names from mark_failed may break other importers/tests
findings.body: `SimpleCheckIn`, `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and the HUMAN_FAILURE maps were removed from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and moved to new modules without re-exports. Any other code or tests importing these from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (including tests that `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")`) will now fail with ImportError/AttributeError. The PR does not update any test or call-site files, so either those references need updating or shims/re-exports should be added.

findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context builds a config copy it never uses
findings.body: The function copies `monitor.config` and rewrites `schedule_type` to its display value, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original), so the human-readable schedule_type substitution is silently dropped and the raw numeric schedule_type is emitted in the monitor context. Should return `config`.
